description: Abstract base class for media file formatter in Drupal, defining settings, applicability, and rendering logic for media files with support for multiple display types and MIME type filtering.

classes.name: FileMediaFormatterBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing media file formatting capabilities, including settings, applicability checks, and rendering for media files in Drupal.

methods.name: getHtmlTag
methods.description: Returns the HTML tag used for media formatting, based on media type.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the formatter, including controls, autoplay, loop, and display type.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for formatter settings, such as controls visibility, autoplay, loop, and display type.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the formatter is applicable to a given field definition based on file extension MIME types.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of current formatter settings for display.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for the media files, including caching tags.

methods.name: prepareAttributes
methods.description: Prepares HTML attributes for media tags based on current settings.

methods.name: mimeTypeApplies
methods.description: Determines if a MIME type matches the media type supported by the formatter.

methods.name: getSourceFiles
methods.description: Retrieves source files with associated attributes, filtered by MIME type and display settings.
